Name: CP - Better Fishing Additions for Better Fishing and Beach Foraging Mod
Author: Plurffle
TagLine: Retextures some of the remaining vanilla fish sprites to match cometkins' WIP Better Fishing and Foraging mod.
Description:
**UPDATE AS OF JUNE 2025:**
Cometkins has completed their Better Fishing and Beach Foraging mod, therefore this mod is obsolete! Go support the original creator, their art is amazing! <3

This mod was made to serve as an extension for the [(WIP) Better Fishing and Beach Foraging](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6915) and [Fish and Aquarium reskin for -Better Fishing and Beach Foraging-](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13136) mods to fill up the unfinished gaps.

I just really like using their mods because of how unique and colorful the fishes looked in-game, but I was a little bummed to see that some of the fishes still didn't have retextures, so I took it upon myself to make them.

This was made for personal use, but I figured I'd share them publicly here. This mod is complete as of version 1.2.0, so having this mod along with the other two mods should ensure that you'll have a bit more splashes of colors in your oceans and rivers (I highly recommend downloading the [Visible Fish](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897) mod for this!).

This mod comes with a config that allows you to pick and choose which sprite replacers you'd like to use. This also comes with two versions of the blobfish (normal version and decompressed version).

![](https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png)
**Q: How to install this mod?**
**A:** Unzip the zip file and place the "(CP) Better Fishing Additions" folder in your Mods folder.

**Q: Is this mod compatible with mobile/multiplayer?**
**A:** I do not have the mobile version of the game, but I assume it should be work just fine in there since this is a Content Patcher mod. This should definitely work in multiplayer!

![](https://imgur.com/LxEgarJ.png)
**Here are some of my recommended mods for your fish-keeping needs!**

*   [Decorated Fish Tank 장식된 어항 리텍](https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10330719) (not available on nexusmods)

*   [Increased Fish Tank Capacity](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11388)

*   [Sizable Fish](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14267)

*   [Visible Fish](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897)
![](https://imgur.com/lT7uwQV.png)
Major credits to cometkins for their gorgeous [Better Fishing and Beach Foraging](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6915)mod! That mod is the only reason why I decided to try and start drawing some fishes! <3 My attempt at mimicking the style isn't the best, but I think I did a __decent__ enough job. I'll definitely update the sprites a bit more if I could figure out how to tweak them better!

I have a Ko-fi account! If you like my works, feel free to [buy me a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle) ~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
